_meta.description: 基因 → 遗传模式（inheritance mode）映射，合并自 ClinGen gene-disease validity curations 与 HPO (Human Phenotype Ontology)

sources.clingen: ClinGen gene-disease validity curations (https://search.clinicalgenome.org/kb/gene-validity), 本地文件 2026-06-18
